literalGroups.primaryGround: The prompt asks for Mega Drive’s Japanese launch date; SEGA lists 1988-10-29 (L103-L104). The three alternate dates are independently listed by SEGA for Master System 1987-10-18, Saturn 1994-11-22 and Dreamcast 1998-11-27. All four are Japanese console release dates; only the Mega Drive date answers the prompt.
